name: application-album-grid-card
title: Album Grid Card
description: Square album-cover grid tile with a hover-revealed play overlay and title/artist text — distinct from dish-card, which is a horizontal food-photo card with price and rating rather than a square media grid tile.
useWhen: Displaying a browsable grid of albums or playlists with cover art.
You want a play action to appear only on hover/focus without disrupting the grid layout.
Title and artist should be legible below the art rather than overlaid on it.
avoidWhen: You're showing food items with price and rating — use dish-card instead.
You need a full track list with playback state — use track-list-row instead.
The grid needs drag-to-reorder — use queue-list instead.
responsiveBehavior: Cards are fixed-width and wrap in a flex/grid container; the cover art scales as a square via aspect-square so it never distorts.
accessibility: The play button has a descriptive aria-label naming the track and artist, not just an icon.
The overlay is reachable via keyboard focus (focus-visible), not hover-only.
Title and artist are always-visible text below the art, never conveyed only via the hover overlay.

variants.title: Album grid card
variants.description: A four-card grid of album covers with one card showing its hover play overlay in a persistent-on state, on a light surface.
accessibility: Each play button's aria-label names both the track title and artist.

variants.title: Album grid card (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-card album grid, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The overlay play button meets WCAG AA contrast against the darkened cover art on dark surfaces.
